question.text: Fund of Funds (FoF) investing in other Cat III AIFs:

answer.text: Has lower total fees than a single-strategy hedge fund
Has substantially higher fees due to double-layered management fees

explanation.text: The Logic: FoF fees = manager fees of underlying hedge funds + additional FoF manager layer — materially higher total fees. The Trap: Lower fees is counterfactual; FoFs ARE permitted in India; performance fee still applies. Cross-Exam Context: Global FoF data: 6.35% of total hedge fund AUM (per Barclays Q1 2023). Distributor's Pro-Tip: FoF pitches must highlight fee-layering so investors aren't blindsided by total cost.
